summary: Wheat is already planted and a Windmill stands, so the main work is a Bakery (needs Stone from a Quarry), a Sawmill for three Plank Houses, and a Warehouse that ends up holding 20 Logs. 80 Bread is only 10 Flour and 10 Sticks. Miranda makes wheat grow faster.

build_order.note: 4 Logs. Build early so Logs start flowing into it, but count the 20 last.
9 Clay (8 in stock, Clay Pit present) + 4 Stone. 1 Flour + 1 Stick makes 8 Bread: 10 batches for 80.
Optional: 20 Veggies in stock; 10-day crop with 3 per tile, so 10 tiles planted early is enough.

pitfalls: Construction draws Logs from the Warehouse; finish building before relying on the 20-Log count.
Every Bakery batch burns a Stick and there is no Firewood Yard here: leave some fallen Sticks for the oven.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
